verification.title: Human verification
verification.description: Configure the verification service used by registration and other risk-sensitive actions.
verification.keepSecretPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current secret
verification.challengeTTLHint: Unit: minutes. Recommended: 20 minutes; 10 is stricter, while 30-60 fits slower forms.
verification.costHint: ALTCHA cost is the client-side PBKDF2 work factor. Higher values make user devices compute longer; start with 1000, then test 3000 or 5000 for higher-risk sites.
verification.secretHint: Use a 32-byte random secret. A new secret replaces the current one only after saving; leaving this empty keeps the existing secret.
verification.secretGenerated: New ALTCHA secret generated. Save to apply it.
verification.secretGenerateUnavailable: This browser cannot generate secure random values.

scenarios.title: Enabled scenarios
scenarios.description: When the service is ALTCHA, these scenarios can require verification; API checks remain authoritative.

register.label: User registration
register.description: Require verification before a new account submits the registration form.

passwordReset.label: Password reset
passwordReset.description: Require verification before account recovery or reset email requests once that flow is wired.

loginRisk.label: Login risk
loginRisk.description: Require verification for suspicious IPs, repeated failures, or new-device login risk.

postRisk.label: Posting risk
postRisk.description: Require verification when publishing, replying, or high-frequency actions trigger risk controls.

widget.title: Client widget behavior
widget.description: These settings are delivered directly to the ALTCHA widget and control what users see and when verification starts.
widget.typeHint: Checkbox is recommended. Switch is lighter; native follows browser controls more closely.
widget.autoHint: Keeping this off is recommended so users trigger verification intentionally; riskier forms can use focus or submit.
widget.displayHint: Standard is the safest default; floating or overlay can fit tighter forms.
widget.hideLogoHint: Keeps the registration form cleaner without changing server verification.
widget.hideFooterHint: Hides the widget attribution footer while keeping the core verification flow.
widget.workersHint: Recommended: 2. Higher values can finish faster but use more low-end device resources; range 1-16.
widget.minDurationHint: Unit: milliseconds. Recommended: 500 for steady feedback; 0 adds no extra wait.
